name: Individual Person 44
definition: Human entity, as distinguished from a corporate entity (which is sometimes referred to as an 'artificial person').

Gender.name: Gender
Gender.definition: Specifies the gender of the person.

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: Language in which a person communicates.

BirthDate.name: Birth Date
BirthDate.definition: Date on which a person is born.

CountryOfBirth.name: Country Of Birth
CountryOfBirth.definition: Country where a person was born.

ProvinceOfBirth.name: Province Of Birth
ProvinceOfBirth.definition: Province where a person was born.

CityOfBirth.name: City Of Birth
CityOfBirth.definition: City where a person was born.

TaxationCountry.name: Taxation Country
TaxationCountry.definition: Country of taxation of an individual person.

CountryAndResidentialStatus.name: Country And Residential Status
CountryAndResidentialStatus.definition: Country and residential status of an individual, for example, non-permanent resident.

PostalAddress.name: Postal Address
PostalAddress.definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.

SecondaryCommunicationAddress.name: Secondary Communication Address
SecondaryCommunicationAddress.definition: Communication device number or electronic address used for communication to an alternate address.

OtherDetails.name: Other Details
OtherDetails.definition: Additional information required for the account switch.
